# M5 Studio Miami

> M5 Studio Miami is an interior design studio in Miami, Florida (M5 STUDIO MIAMI LLC). M5 designs and coordinates; one accountable team designs it, coordinates it and answers for it. Construction is performed by licensed & insured Florida contractor partners under their own permit and contract. Services, in this order: full renovations of condos, apartments and houses; Venetian plaster (marmorino, mineral plaster) hand-applied by our own masters; interior design. Service area: South Florida: Miami-Dade first, plus Broward and Palm Beach counties. The site is in English, Spanish, Ukrainian and Russian.

## What M5 does

- Full renovations (condos, apartments, houses): renovation design and coordination from demolition to décor, kitchens and bathrooms included. Itemized budget before the contract, change orders signed by the client first, milestone payments, weekly photo updates, condo-board paperwork (COI, elevator bookings, noise hours) coordinated by M5. Built with licensed & insured Florida contractor partners under their own permit and contract; they pull the permits. A typical design + renovation project is $200–250K.
- Venetian plaster and mineral wall finishes (our signature): Venetian plaster, marmorino and mineral plaster, hand-applied on walls, ceilings, fireplaces, bathrooms, powder rooms and façades. Plaster projects from $10,000; a real hand-made sample within 48 hours, free site visit, fixed written price.
- Interior design: concept, layouts, 3D visualization, materials and documentation.

## Key facts

- A typical design + renovation project is $200–250K. Every project is priced after a site visit.
- Venetian plaster projects start at $10,000; the exact price depends on material, area and substrate and is fixed in writing after a free site visit.
- Timeline: sample in 48 h; an accent wall 2–3 days on site; a full room about a week. A typical renovation takes up to 3 months.
- Mineral plaster is seamless, breathable, washable and repairable, suited to Miami humidity and air conditioning; wet zones are sealed.
- Sample library: full-size samples brought to your home or site by appointment. The studio works online and on site (no public showroom).
- Service area: South Florida: Miami-Dade first, plus Broward and Palm Beach counties.
